data.title: {{brand_name}} SMS Terms
intro: These terms apply to text messages sent by {{brand_name}}.

sections.heading: What we text about
paragraphs: {{brand_name}} sends text messages to customers who agreed to receive them: {{message_types}}.

sections.heading: How you agree
paragraphs: You agree to receive text messages from {{brand_name}} when you give us your mobile number and your consent, by phone, in person or on a form. Consent is not a condition of purchase.

sections.heading: Message frequency and rates
paragraphs: Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply.

sections.heading: How to stop
paragraphs: Reply STOP to any message to stop receiving texts. We will send one message confirming you are unsubscribed and will not text you again unless you reply START.

sections.heading: Help
paragraphs: Reply HELP to any message for help, or contact us:

sections.heading: Carriers
paragraphs: Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: Your mobile information and SMS consent will not be sold or shared with third parties for marketing or promotional purposes. Read our privacy policy: {{privacy_url}}

data.footer: This page is provided by FirstMate on behalf of {{brand_name}}.
